values.name: search results, Path column
values.value: details view, between Name and Size, while the walk covers subfolders and at least one hit lies in a folder below the root
values.source: own addition, asked for by the person; the original's find bar hands its results to KIO's search helper, which has no such column

values.name: search results, Path column width
values.value: measured: the widest name and the widest folder in the result, laid out with the row's own fonts (13 px / 12 px); leftover room split evenly; when the row cannot hold both, Size and Modified shrink to what their own cells need (44 / 64 px floors) before anything is elided
values.source: own rule; a fixed share capped at 240 px cut folders, and a character estimate with a 220 px floor for the name cut names

values.name: search results, Path text
values.value: the folder relative to the folder searched; an em dash for a file in that folder itself
values.source: own rule; the find bar above already names the root

values.name: find bar close button
values.value: drawn glyph, not a character; laid out against the row's right edge before the field
values.source: own fix: the ✕ character is absent from this app's font and the button was laid out past the window edge while a search ran

values.name: the light palette
values.value: per-role pairs (theme::pair): a dark value and a light value written for paper - view #fbfcfd, panel #eef2f5, toolbar #e6ebf0, ink #1a1d20, accent #1b6e9e, band #2f79ac; theme::c() (hue kept, saturation x0.92, L' = 1 - L^1.6) is left for icon glyphs and the viewer's scrims
values.source: own rule, asked for by the person; the derived palette squashed the ladder into 1.05:1 steps, made the border the brightest line in the window, and left the accent at 2.24:1

values.name: the light palette's contrast targets
values.value: both modes, asserted by --selftest: view<->toolbar >= 1.12:1; view<->panel >= 1.05:1; ink >= 7:1; dim and faint >= 4.5:1 on the panel (faint >= 4.0 on the toolbar); hairline >= 1.18:1; window edge >= 1.25:1 from the toolbar; hover >= 1.10:1; band >= 1.9:1 with white text >= 4.5:1; accent >= 3:1; white on a filled or destructive button >= 4.5:1; no role a pure #000 or #fff
values.source: Hallmark's rule that a second mode is re-derived, never inverted, and held to the same contrast in both; the old check only proved surfaces were light and text was dark

values.name: the light palette switch
values.value: app menu > View > Light Mode; config key light, absent = dark; --light for one session
values.source: own addition; egui's Visuals are set again on the switch (theme::apply_style)

values.name: light mode, colours the derivation must not touch
values.value: image tints are Color32::WHITE; white/black used in blend maths are the constants; strong text is text(); text on a band or a filled button is on_band(), white in both modes; text on a black scrim is on_scrim()
values.source: own fix: a blanket derivation turned every preview black, inverted the folder highlight into a shadow, and made every emphasised name white on white

values.name: document icon page edge
values.value: paper_edge(): the page's own colour in dark mode (invisible), a grey line in light mode where a white page on a white view has no shape
values.source: own fix: file types without a coloured badge read as a floating glyph in light mode

values.name: widget strong text
values.value: Visuals::widgets.active.fg_stroke = text(), because RichText::strong() takes its colour from there
values.source: egui 0.33 style.rs strong_text_color() -> widgets.active.text_color()

values.name: create new menu
values.value: a right-click on the folder's own space (not on an item) opens Create New -> Folder… / Text File…; the app menu's New group carries New Folder… (F10) and New Text File…; both kinds share one window whose name is preselected
values.source: libKF6KIOFileWidgets.so.6 strings '@item:inmenu Create New', 'Create New Folder', 'Create New File', 'Enter file name', template 'Name=Text File...'; /usr/bin/dolphin action names 'create_dir' and 'create_file'

values.name: new text file
values.value: an empty file made with create_new(true): a name that is already taken is refused, never emptied
values.source: own choice: create_file makes an empty file; create_new keeps a mistyped name from truncating the file that already has it
